name: Burning Blood
summary: In Stormwind, Grimand Elmore turns to Furen Longbeard’s smithing methods. He needs burning blood and a burning rock from Duskwood to test the armorcrafting technique himself.

sections.title: A Reluctant Experiment
sections.body: Grimand Elmore is one of the Alliance’s accomplished armorers, and he rarely accepts that another smith might surpass his methods. Hearing of Furen Longbeard’s unusual smithing discoveries stirs his professional curiosity. Grimand agrees to test Furen’s methods by making a piece of armor. He needs strange, volatile components from the dark reaches of the south to quench and temper the metal to his exact requirements; ordinary water and common coals will not do.

sections.title: The Horrors of Roland's Doom
sections.body: Grimand sends you to Duskwood, to the abandoned mine called Roland’s Doom. Savage Nightbane worgen have overrun its tunnels, their cursed veins pulsing with burning ichor. He needs vials of their burning blood and a rare, flaming core called a burning rock, carried by the pack’s leader, Gutspill. Bring these scorching materials back so Grimand can test Furen’s methods at the forge.

faq.answer: Grimand Elmore is a respected master armorer in Stormwind’s Dwarven District. He works with other craftsmen to equip the city’s defenders and trains aspiring warriors in the weight and strength of proper battle plate.

faq.q: Why does Grimand want burning blood and a burning rock?
faq.answer: Grimand wants to test an armorcrafting technique developed by Furen Longbeard. The burning blood and burning rock provide the supernatural heat needed to forge and temper specialized armor plates.

faq.q: Where do I find the Nightbane worgen carrying these materials?
faq.answer: You can find the materials in Duskwood at Roland’s Doom, an abandoned mine in southeastern Duskwood, southwest of Darkshire. Nightbane worgen fill its tunnels and carry the burning blood.
Gutspill, a powerful leader among the Nightbane worgen, carries the burning rock deep within Roland’s Doom.

faq.q: What is the relationship between Grimand Elmore and Furen Longbeard?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard is Grimand Elmore’s former student. Grimand is usually skeptical of outside ideas, but Furen’s latest armorcrafting methods have persuaded him to test them firsthand.

faq.q: What happens after returning the blood and rock?
faq.answer: Grimand begins forging armor after receiving the fiery reagents, to test Furen’s methods. He promises the finished piece to the adventurer who gathered the materials.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can brave Duskwood’s cursed beasts for Grimand’s experiment and earn uniquely tempered armor made for the front lines.
As a blacksmith, you can see Grimand test the methods of his former student, Furen, with rare metals and quenching agents.
As an Alliance member, you can recover reagents from Roland’s Doom, helping check the worgen threat in Duskwood and supply Stormwind’s armories with new defensive methods.
